use default

sundaram(limit: int) -> Pipe[int] is
    let marked = LIST(limit + 1)

    (0::limit)
        |> each(_ => marked.add(false))

    for step in 1::limit do
        if step + step + 2 * step * step > limit then break fi

        let other mut = step

        while step + other + 2 * step * other <= limit do
            marked[step + other + 2 * step * other] = true
            other = other + 1
        od
    od

    for value in 1::limit do
        if !marked[value] then
            yield 2 * value + 1
        fi
    od

let limit = 7_800_000

write_line("the first 100 odd primes from the sieve of Sundaram:")

sundaram(limit)
    |> take(100)
    |> chunk(10)
    |> each(row => write_line(row |> map(p => "{p,5}") |> join("")))

write_line()

let millionth = sundaram(limit) |> skip(999_999) |> first_or_throw()

write_line("the millionth: {millionth:N0}")
